Thank you all for taking time to read and respond to my previous post. It’s taken some time but I’ll address the major concerns and your feedback. 

1. Stickies 

Generally most users are happy with how stickies have been handled recently but there are a few changes we’ll try to implement. 

A) more memes 
B) less European content 
C) more actionable content 
D) leave some posts up longer 

I fully support all these ideas but we are still limited by what is posted. If it’s 5am in DC there’s more European content than US content. If you want better content on the front make sure that content is posted. 

2. Moderation 

Users overwhelmingly want the current rules followed and followed strictly. If your motivation is to doom and not vote then you’re going to have a bad time going forward. Unlike what some users have stated we do not overly moderate this site. We will moderate according to the rules and it’s our expectation that you follow those rules.  Regardless of account age you may be banned.

2a. Bans

Any person who ever wants unbanned may privately message me and so long as they have an undeleted history I’ll review their ban to make sure it was just. 

3. Adhering to those rules 

Finally our request for more mods. Hundreds have applied and I’ll be going through the list and verification process shortly. If you applied and I haven’t gotten back to you, don’t worry I will get back to everyone with some more questions.


   Some unlisted topics that were popular and not something I originally intended to discuss.

A) downvotes, we aren’t bringing them back at this moment as users have been attempting to manipulate voting and pushing their own narratives with downvotes. There’s more into this than just that but hopefully we can add them back in the future.

B) location tags, we don’t store this and care more about the 99% or your privacy than the 1% of users from the Muslim nation of England.


Thanks for your time and attention to this matter
